title: 🔅🔅 US Strategic Centers in Kuwait Targeted by Army Drones
text:
🔅🔅 US Strategic Centers in Kuwait Targeted by Army Drones"

"Army Public Relations Department: In the 27th phase of Operation Lightning, and in response to recent aggressions by the US terrorist military against our country and their brutal attack on a residential home on Qeshm Island, the Iranian Army’s destructive drones targeted the "fighter hangars," "satellite communication systems," and "equipment warehouses" of this child-killing military at the Ahmad al-Jaber base in Kuwait a few hours ago."

"The Ahmad al-Jaber base in Kuwait plays a major role in US air and surveillance operations. Beyond its operational function, it is considered one of the vital air support hubs for the US terrorist military."

"Crimes, sanctions, and threats only serve to make Iran more united and cohesive in its sacred defense."

"The decisive, extensive, and high-volume attacks by the Iranian Army and the IRGC make intercepting Iran's drones and missiles extremely costly and difficult for the enemy, despite their use of the most advanced defense systems and their constant reinforcement. The malicious enemy is forced to resort to heavy censorship to prevent the spread of news regarding the damages, casualties, and injuries.
